prompt: Williamson ether synthesis of 1-methoxy-2-methylpropane: sodium methoxide (NaOMe) + 1-bromo-2-methylpropane. Draw the product.
explanation: Alkoxide + 1° alkyl halide is clean SN2. If you tried the alternative (NaO-iBu + MeBr), it would also work, but with 2°/3° halides E2 would dominate — Williamson needs the halide primary.
